questions.question: What did God command the king of Judah to do in Jeremiah 22?
options: Do justice and righteousness, and deliver the oppressed
Gather to himself yet more horses and chariots for the war
Make a binding treaty with the king of the land of Egypt
Build for himself a far grander palace than all his fathers
questions.answer: Do justice and righteousness, and deliver the oppressed
